targetTexts.1: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in His own likeness.
targetTexts.2: Male and female He created them, and He blessed them. And in the day they were created, He called them “man.”
targetTexts.3: When Adam was 130 years old, he had a son in his own likeness, after his own image; and he named him Seth.
targetTexts.4: And after he had become the father of Seth, Adam lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.5: So Adam lived a total of 930 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.6: When Seth was 105 years old, he became the father of Enosh.
targetTexts.7: And after he had become the father of Enosh, Seth lived 807 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.8: So Seth lived a total of 912 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.9: When Enosh was 90 years old, he became the father of Kenan.
targetTexts.10: And after he had become the father of Kenan, Enosh lived 815 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.11: So Enosh lived a total of 905 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.12: When Kenan was 70 years old, he became the father of Mahalalel.
targetTexts.13: And after he had become the father of Mahalalel, Kenan lived 840 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.14: So Kenan lived a total of 910 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.15: When Mahalalel was 65 years old, he became the father of Jared.
targetTexts.16: And after he had become the father of Jared, Mahalalel lived 830 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.17: So Mahalalel lived a total of 895 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.18: When Jared was 162 years old, he became the father of Enoch.
targetTexts.19: And after he had become the father of Enoch, Jared lived 800 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.20: So Jared lived a total of 962 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.21: When Enoch was 65 years old, he became the father of Methuselah.
targetTexts.22: And after he had become the father of Methuselah, Enoch walked with God 300 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.23: So Enoch lived a total of 365 years.
targetTexts.24: Enoch walked with God, and then he was no more, because God had taken him away.
targetTexts.25: When Methuselah was 187 years old, he became the father of Lamech.
targetTexts.26: And after he had become the father of Lamech, Methuselah lived 782 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.27: So Methuselah lived a total of 969 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.28: When Lamech was 182 years old, he had a son.
targetTexts.29: And he named him Noah, saying, “May this one comfort us in the labor and toil of our hands caused by the ground that the LORD has cursed.”
targetTexts.30: And after he had become the father of Noah, Lamech lived 595 years and had other sons and daughters.
targetTexts.31: So Lamech lived a total of 777 years, and then he died.
targetTexts.32: After Noah was 500 years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
